send_non_streaming_request: send a non-streaming A2A request to a Pydantic AI agent and wait for task completion
send_and_get_raw_response: send a request to a Pydantic AI agent and return the raw task response with history and artifacts
fake_streaming_from_response: convert a non-streaming A2A response into fake streaming chunks with delays between chunks
transform_to_a2a_response: transform a Pydantic AI task response into standard A2A non-streaming format
extract_response_text: extract response text from a completed Pydantic AI task response
